rationale: Operator has Claude-only access. Under single-family policy, the Adversarial Checklist (antigravity-taxonomy.md section 4) is the primary anti-gaming defense on every review session, replacing cross-family separation.

notes.fallback: When `.agents/vendor-policy.json` does not exist, rules R11 and R17(c) assume `cross-family` (backwards-compatible default).
notes.upgradeToCrossFamily: If cross-family access becomes available later, flip `policy` to `cross-family` and set `reviewFamily` accordingly. Prior same-family validation reports remain valid history; new reviews run cross-family from that point forward.
